description: ROGUE ROBOTS (a city event the Games Master can draw): read what is happening now. While it runs it shows the district, five rogue units that appear one after another, each unit's clue once it is loose (an event name from the Games Master's published rules), who disabled which unit, the live scoreboard and the locked answer hashes. Outside it, it says when the next one is drawn, if known. Read only, no token.
name: rogue_state
